notes.title: Germ Wars Remastered announcement!
notes.content:
[b]Thanks for still playing Germ Wars![/b]

It's been a while since the release of this game, it was my first big project and I've since learned quite a few things regarding game development, and I've switched to a new engine. The current build still has many bugs and crashes that shouldn't be there.

With that, I've decided to [b]remake the entire game[/b] in the new engine, and improve the overall experience! ːvirus_joyː

The core of the game will be the same, but here's what you can expect once it is done:

[list]
    [*]Massive performance increase
    [*]Better menus
    [*]Bug fixes
    [*]Better balance
    [*]Better gameplay
    [*]Steam Stats
    [*]Steam Cloud
    [*]Windowed and fullscreen modes
[/list]

Release date is [url=http://wowwiki.wikia.com/wiki/Soon]SOON[/url]

notes.title: Sol Ni Koro - Greenlight + Kickstarter
notes.content:
[B]Sol Ni Koro[/B] is an epic 3D RPG mixed with 2D pixel sprites. Inspired by the golden era of video games, designed for the modern era.
[h1]Steam Greenlight page[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=866997534
[IMG]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/616/620/3b50e1ea6489f6bd61ee447cb3bc37b7_original.gif?w=680&fit=max&v=1487873984&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=3cadac640758f4cbed6bcfdb911d2186[/IMG]

[H1]Our Goal[/H1]
From day one we set out to develop an exciting and compelling RPG with a vast story and interesting characters. The project that emerged became a modern RPG that evokes nostalgia, but also improves on many of the pitfalls of classic RPGs that we remember so fondly.

Modern technology has allowed us to design and develop a beautiful and vast 3D world, with stunning towns, dungeons, depth of field and verticality that adds to the game's atmosphere. The 360 degree camera allows the player to fully explore the 3D environment, rotating and zooming to find hidden paths or just to get a better look at the world.
[IMG]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/527/476/858d17c1d23756d07f08f5b0e56cb844_original.gif?w=680&fit=max&v=1487241683&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=41b1f105dd335dbd481e2c47f1a54f8d[/IMG]

[H1]The Story[/H1]
[I]'When men turn to an ancient darkness to enslave the world, the sun will bless the chosen four with the power of fallen gods'[/I]

Two hundred years ago a great war waged between man and magic. This conflict created giant fissures in the earth's surface, which began to spew a strange mist that conjured terrible monsters. Today, the people of Varos fear magic and those who possess the power to wield it.

[h1]Step into a world rich with history and lore[/h1]
As you travel through Varos, you'll learn about the history of the world and its inhabitants. In particular, you'll hear about the ancient war, how it almost destroyed Varos, how it caused continents to be split into islands and how it left scar-like rifts along the planet's terrain.
[IMG]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/ff4524_cd0a5837295c43d48c9f69ee94b1a77f~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_1721,h_971,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/ff4524_cd0a5837295c43d48c9f69ee94b1a77f~mv2.webp[/IMG]

[H1]The Characters[/h1]
Varos is a world ample with diversity and well-developed races. It was important during the writing process to explore different kinds of beings, including the beings living in Varos. You'll discover an interesting mix of races as you play, each one with its own variety of lifestyles, beliefs, and outlooks on life.
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/563/949/f09da4a0c5319ec74838b75be0ac3b67_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1487528380&auto=format&lossless=true&s=1013984bb12988a55bbf70aa9186a518[/img]

[h1]Exploring Varos[/h1]
We've designed the world of Varos to be both vast and beautiful. We really want the player to make the most of the camera design, rotating and zooming to get a better look at the world and environments as they travel and explore. We will also be using this opportunity to hide secret areas, loot and Easter eggs in Sol Ni Koro.
[h1]No forced backtracking![/h1]
We're avoiding filler, so there will be be no forced backtracking through areas the player has previously visited. Sure, you can backtrack if you want to search for secret areas, loot or just power level your party. But you absolutely shouldn't have to.
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/ff4524_6e38ed57c0ee4aeda9083ce922b51886~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_1920,h_1080,al_c,q_90/ff4524_6e38ed57c0ee4aeda9083ce922b51886~mv2.webp[/img]

[H1]The Combat System[/h1]
The combat system in Sol Ni Koro has been designed to be at its core fast paced and streamlined, but also fun and exciting!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/552/797/c33cc0abc99afdc6bd9a774acf495e9e_original.gif?w=680&fit=max&v=1487420053&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=62255a06c0267d842726b3ad099b7f86[/img]
[h1]Unique Character Skills[/h1]
Each playable character in Sol Ni Koro has a completely unique skill set. Characters will gain new skills in two ways: 
[B]1.[/B] Levelling up 
[B]2. [/B]Equipping 'Scrolls' 
Each character and his or her skill set will prove useful in different battle situations. For example, Nova's skill set 'Magic Arts' is focused around offensive magic, while Lalune's skill set 'Sword Arts' leans towards physical/elemental attacks and de-buffing the enemy.

[h1]Scrolls[/h1]
[I]'Ancient parchments left behind for those that have been blessed by the Sun'[/I]

When equipped to a character a scroll will grant a visible stat boost. But what's particularly interesting about scrolls is that they will grant an invisible bonus too. Some scrolls will grant the character a special ability, skill/spell or secret stat boost as well. Scrolls will also behave differently when equipped by different characters, it's all about experimenting!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/553/584/9fcbebe1f69732ac59643a68a766ad2e_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1487428294&auto=format&lossless=true&s=babf3560d563cc2046a4a54e9bc3567f[/img]


[H1]Sol Ni Koro on Kickstarter![/h1]
Check out the Sol Ni Koro Kickstarter campaign, get exclusive rewards, goodies and more!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/solnikoro/sol-ni-koro-a-handcrafted-3d-rpg-with-2d-pixel-spr?ref=card


[H1]Back To Basics Gaming Discord server[/H1]
Join our discord server: 
https://discord.gg/VqpNf7s

notes.title: Germ Wars Update v1.1
notes.content:
Good news! Germ Wars has just been updated with two major features:

[b]Partial controller support[/b] - you can now control your White Blood Cell with your usb controller. The controls can be mapped in the Controls Menu.


[b]German language localization[/b] - you can change between English and German in the Options menu. 

Steam Achievements have also been localized, and Store page will be localized soon as well.


[b]Minor changes:[/b]
*Health perk 2 attachment is not on top now, so all other attachments will not be hidden anymore when selecting that perk
*minor bug fixes


Have fun! ːvirus_happyː

notes.title: Patch Nov 23rd 2016
notes.content:
Changelog Nov 23rd 2016:

*fixed stats for exploder and chaser kills not saving after closing the game

*fixed the 5000 total kills achievement not activating

*far away germs no longer disappear when zoomed out

*added the kill counter for each session

*added the total time stat in the stats menu

*minor balancing

notes.title: Germ Wars hotfix
notes.content:
We've just uploaded a small patch:
[list]
    [*][b]Breeder achievements now work[/b] (you may not get the notification if you've already met the requirement before the patch, but it will show up in your achievements list when you enter the game)
    [*][b]Collectible DNA now disappears after some time[/b] to prevent memory leaks and give the player incentive to collect it as soon as possible
[/list]

Have fun!
